candidats.description: Incorporating traditional Nubian motifs and cultural practices, the Nubian Village at Aswan is full of vernacular buildings built of concrete and masonry, which express the unique indigenous culture of the Nubian people. The village at Aswan was settled beginning in the 1960s, as the Aswan High Dam was under construction and threatened former indigenous lands and settlements with inundation. As the Nubians are somewhat distinct culturally from the rest of Egypt, they created new settlements in areas that were available, but often separate from other people.
